G1_DATA_VALIDITY.detail: 20,000 synthetic dev records + 12 real Data/ files inventoried; provenance recorded per file.

G2_LABEL_VALIDITY.detail: 0 verified positives, 0 verified negatives at calibration-eligible evidence. NULL was not converted to 0.

G3_FEATURE_AVAILABILITY.detail: 0 labelled rows carry budget/expenditure features; no bid table exists anywhere.

G4_COVERAGE.detail: Audit year {2020-21} vs structured years {2023-24..2026-27}: intersection empty. 1 state in common.

G6_TEMPORAL_GENERALIZATION.detail: No labels, so no performance to measure across time.

G7_PROBABILITY_CALIBRATION.detail: Blocked by G2/G4. Stage 8 calibrate() returns INSUFFICIENT_LABELS.

G8_ARTIFACT_INVARIANCE.detail: Dev corpus has a single source_file, so no artifact grouping has 2 classes. Re-run when multi-source real data exists.

G9_STABILITY.detail: Requires re-running Stages 3-5 per subsample; not executed this pass.

G11_EXPLAINABILITY.detail: Every record carries risk_explanation and a canonical explanation_payload from Stage 6.

_verdict: Stage 8 REFUSES to calibrate. The binding constraint is data coverage, not model quality: the single available audit report covers a financial year that no structured dataset covers. No threshold was fitted, no label was manufactured, and no gate was weakened.
_what_would_change_it: District- or work-level PMGSY financial data for FY2020-21 covering Nagaland (OMMAS).
Audit SCOPE, not just findings - which units were examined and cleared. Without scope there are no negatives and NULL is the only honest value.
Tender-level bid data (tender_id, bid_amount, is_winner, n_bidders) to make the bid-rigging typologies reachable at all.
